blinding_guess.why: In rmw_destroy_node (both rmw_fastrtps_cpp/src/rmw_node.cpp:93 and rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp/src/rmw_node.cpp:93) the result of __rmw_destroy_node is stored in inner_ret but the following check tests `if (RMW_RET_OK != ret)`, where ret was just initialised to RMW_RET_OK, so a failure of __rmw_destroy_node is silently dropped and the function can return RMW_RET_OK. The ten declared signatures themselves are identical across both implementations; I did not compare them with rmw/rmw.h, which is not in the snapshot.

notes: The snapshot is the rmw_fastrtps repository, holding three ament packages all at version 8.5.0 (rmw_fastrtps_cpp/package.xml:5, rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp/package.xml:5, rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/package.xml:5); there is no package named exactly rmw_fastrtps. All ten packet elements are C functions defined inside extern "C" blocks in both RMW implementations, rmw_fastrtps_cpp and rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp, with textually identical signatures (dynamic_cpp lines: rmw_node.cpp:39 and :78, rmw_publisher.cpp:68 and :202, rmw_service.cpp:70 and :495, rmw_subscription.cpp:64 and :194, rmw_publish.cpp:28, rmw_wait.cpp:23); declares strings are the return-type line plus the parameter list with whitespace collapsed; provenance cites the rmw_fastrtps_cpp copy. Each implementation delegates to rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp::__rmw_* helpers. The prototypes are declared by the external rmw package header rmw/rmw.h (#include "rmw/rmw.h", e.g. rmw_fastrtps_cpp/src/rmw_node.cpp:27; <build_depend>rmw</build_depend> at rmw_fastrtps_cpp/package.xml:28), which this repository implements; that header is not in the snapshot and was not fetched, so conformance was not checked.
